description: vim --clean (Git for Windows, LANG=en_US.UTF-8, ConPTY): alternate screen, mouse/focus/paste modes, appended lines with accents, CJK, emoji and a combining mark, :set number, :q!
notes: Emoji typed into vim show as <dXXX> surrogate halves: the MSYS2 vim reads console input as UTF-16 code units. That is what this vim prints, not an emulator bug.
